If {for win}Windows{/for} high contrast mode is making it difficult to view some web pages, you can disable it in Firefox:

{for not fx152}
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Select the {menu General} panel and scroll down to ''Language and Appearance''.
#Under '''Colors''', click the {button Manage Colors…} button. 
#;[[Image:ColorsPanel_Settings|width=400]]
#In the drop-down menu under ''Override the colors specified by the page with your selections above'' choose {menu Never}.
#;[[Image:high contrast fx desktop|width=400]]
#Click {button OK} to save your changes.
{/for}
{for fx152}
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Select the {menu Accessibility} page and scroll down to ''Website contrast''.
#Under '''Override colors''', click the {button Off} radio button. 
#;[[Image:fx152websitecontrast]]
{/for}
